answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Tin washer solder proof soldered into the soldering bench, and every verdict reads the same way: each solder is a soldering record witnessed by the master tinsmith. The proof holds because it is checked by people who gain nothing by letting it pass. Get caught once and the whole shelf burns: 472 masks, 42480 POA, gone on one grade. Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. A ridge from a stranger, a reef from a ledger, a mirror from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story.
